# Fallout 76 patch notes "Radiant Depths" (Patch 56) December 3, 2024

![Fallout 76 patch notes `Radiant Depths` (Patch 56) December 3rd, 2024](/uploads/433_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Today's Radiant Depths update marks the biggest change to the Fallout 76 endgame experience ever!

Gather your friends and head into the Radiant Depths to face a new challenge together and secure the long-awaited legendary 4-star weapons, armor and mods. Or go to your C.A.M.P. and give a four-legged friend a new home with the new C.A.M.P. pet feature. Since there are also a number of balancing changes to skill cards and combat, we'd better get to the point quickly. **Note**: The Radiant Depths update is so big that we've written an entire additional article full of information about it. The full list of improvements and bug fixes can be found here.

## Update highlights

**The Radiant Depths Raid**: Jump into the Radiant Depths Raid - a new challenging end-game activity for teams of four high-level and well-equipped Vault Dwellers.
**4-Star Legendary Items**: The Legendary system has been expanded to four stars! Upgrade your builds with new 4-star legendary weapons, armor, and mods earned in the Radiant Depths Raid.
**Player Titles**: Earn new titles and express your uniqueness as a Vault Dweller!
**C.A.M.P. Pets**: Yes, they really exist. Add a cat or dog to your C.A.M.P with the C.A.M.P. pet feature. move in! And yes, of course you can pet them.--- ### Update version 1.7.16.13 and download sizes

**PC (Steam)**: 18.6 GB
**PC (Microsoft Store)**: 36.4 GB
**Xbox**: 38.9GB
**PlayStation**: 37.6GB

## The Radiant Depths

The Radiant Depths Raid is a new endgame component for teams of four high-level, well-equipped players. Each encounter challenges you with unique co-op mechanics that you must master as a team to defeat the bosses of each encounter. Some of these bosses are particularly quick to make short work of certain types of character builds - we're sure you'll figure out which builds will benefit you most in which fight. Unlike Daily Operations and Expeditions, which can be completed without the help of other players if you have the appropriate build, teams in the Radiant Depths must clearly regulate who will do what task, and they must communicate with each other to get there. To make communication easier, we have developed a new ping system that allows those who are reluctant to communicate via voice chat to communicate with the team. The ping system can be targeted to a target, marking enemy and friendly targets, areas of interest and containers. During the development of this in-game content, the team established five key pillars that will ensure that the new raids are different from other replayable content. Raids should:

- Require teamwork
- present a challenge for endgame builds
- Offer unique boss fights
- work without time restrictions
- Offer high-quality rewards Since we have already covered the first three basic pillars at the beginning of the article, we will now focus on the remaining two. Raids should work without a time limit. This means that raids can be played back to back without players having to constantly wait for a reset timer to expire.
